title: These IDs Look Identical. XLOOKUP Says NO MATCH #excel #xlookup #shorts
description: Two Excel IDs can look identical and still fail XLOOKUP because imported text may contain an invisible non-breaking space. Microsoft documents that TRIM does not remove character 160 by itself. Diagnose the mismatch with LEN and UNICODE, replace UNICHAR(160), trim the result, and verify the lookup again. #excel #xlookup #datacleaning #shorts
visual_style: proof-first realistic Excel demo with a brief explanatory hidden-character x-ray sweep
research_signal: Microsoft documents that TRIM does not remove non-breaking space 160 by itself; hidden or unexpected characters can prevent exact lookup matches.

captions.text: Looks equal? Check LEN, then Unicode.
